rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but likely overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality and expansion from this single, somewhat suboptimal focal plane image.
Thoroughly integrates age, prior live birth, BMI, endometriosis, AMH/oocyte yield, semen parameters, endometrium, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately balancing favorable and adverse factors; only minor overinterpretation of morphology/protocol implications.

Largely aligned with standard IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including single embryo transfer and avoiding unsupported add-ons; minor speculative comments about natural cycle optimization and suppression strategies prevent a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including luteal support review, cavity assessment, and embryo banking discussion, though some advice remains somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
